title: Famous Figures
description: One hundred sourced quotations from scientists, writers, artists and public figures, drawn from Wikiquote's sourced sections.

quotes.text: I live in that solitude which is painful in youth, but delicious in the years of maturity.
Joy in looking and comprehending is nature's most beautiful gift.

quotes.sourceNote: From the same 24 March 1954 letter as above, p. 44
